snippet.title: The Great Wife's Guide — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Great Wife’s Guide is a dark comedy puzzle game about a housewife trying to commit a perfect murder.

Play as Dolores, a 1950s housewife pushed to her breaking point by a toxic marriage and the pressure of a perfect suburban life. Set up sabotage in short, focused point-and-click puzzle levels, explore retro cartoon dollhouse rooms, and uncover the secrets hidden behind the perfect home.

Wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4881480
